scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r --filter @zeo/contracts build && pnpm -r typecheck && pnpm -C packages/core typecheck:exports
scripts.test:ci: echo 'Running fast tests...' && NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 pnpm -r --filter !@zeo/core --filter !@zeo/warehouse --filter !@zeo/repro-pack test && echo 'Running heavy tests sequentially...' && NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 pnpm -r --filter @zeo/core --filter @zeo/warehouse --filter @zeo/repro-pack --workspace-concurrency=1 test
scripts.verify: pnpm run doctor && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run lint && pnpm run smoke && pnpm run audit
scripts.verify:fast: pnpm run doctor && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run lint
scripts.verify:full: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm run build && pnpm run verify && pnpm audit && pnpm doctor:secrets
scripts.quickstart:web: pnpm install && pnpm -r build && pnpm -C apps/web dev
scripts.quickstart:cli: pnpm install && pnpm -r build && pnpm -C apps/cli start -- --example negotiation
scripts.quickstart:demo: pnpm install && pnpm -r build && pnpm -C apps/cli start -- --replay ../../external/examples/replay/sample_dataset.json --report-out ./reports
scripts.quickstart:all: pnpm verify:full && echo '=== Quickstart: CLI ===' && pnpm quickstart:cli && echo '=== Quickstart: Demo ===' && pnpm quickstart:demo
